record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.context_brief: Concrete separation in the L^{APP}_{r,∞} scale.
record.original_question: Fix Banach spaces X and Y and exponents 0 < r < s < \infty that are both large. Construct explicit or otherwise concrete operators S belonging to L^{APP}_{s,\infty}(X,Y) but not to L^{APP}_{r,\infty}(X,Y), where L^{APP}_{t,\infty}(X,Y) consists of operators whose dyadic approximation numbers satisfy a_{2^k}(S)=O(2^{-k/t}).

evidence.quote:
Problem 19. Assuming that both indices 0 <r<s< ∞ are large, we want
to find ”concrete” operators S ∈ LAPP
s,∞ (X, Y )\LAPP
r,∞ (X, Y ).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ and $Y$ be Banach spaces, and for a bounded linear operator $S\colon X\to Y$ let $a_n(S)$ denote its $n$-th approximation number, defined by
$$a_n(S)=\inf\{\|S-F\|:F\colon X\to Y\text{ is linear with }\operatorname{rank}(F)<n\}.$$
For $0<t<\infty$, define the Lorentz-type approximation operator class
$$\mathcal L^{\mathrm{APP}}_{t,\infty}(X,Y)=\bigl\{S\in\mathcal L(X,Y):\ a_{2^k}(S)=O(2^{-k/t})\text{ as }k\to\infty\bigr\}.$$
Now fix $0<r<s<\infty$ with both indices "large" (say $r,s\geq 2$). Exhibit, for some concrete choice of Banach spaces $X$ and $Y$, an explicit (or otherwise concretely described) bounded linear operator
$$S\in\mathcal L^{\mathrm{APP}}_{s,\infty}(X,Y)\setminus\mathcal L^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}(X,Y),$$
that is, an operator whose dyadic approximation numbers satisfy $a_{2^k}(S)=O(2^{-k/s})$ but for which it is not the case that $a_{2^k}(S)=O(2^{-k/r})$.
artifact.status_search_result: This is posed as an open problem on concrete separation of the Lorentz-type approximation-number scales for large indices. No published resolution was located; the question concerns the construction of explicit operators witnessing strict inclusions, and appears to remain open.
